svg.title: IEC 60309 16 A 3P+N+E 6h socket-outlet and connector (female), mating face
svg.desc: Schematic front view, looking into the socket, major keyway at the bottom (6 h). Five contact tubes on one contact circle: the earth (PE, larger) at 6 h, aligned with the keyway, then clockwise L1 lower left, L2 upper left, L3 upper right and N lower right. Rings are contact tubes (female contacts). Not to scale; the angular spacing is not dimensioned by the cited sources and is drawn even.
